scope: new two-owner conditional synthetic event model; no old-M0, RTL equivalence, native performance, measurements or novelty acceptance
assumptions: Source callback/task/buffer/generation/drain rules retain the accepted clockless projection; this is a separate two-owner timed projection.
All numbers are declared synthetic stress units, not empirical SSD/DDR calibration.
Two owners each have two stable independent 4KiB buffers and distinct per-task IDs; mappings/permissions immutable inside invocation.
Finite device, translation and response slots reserve output space at accepted submit.
One serial ordinary TL/PTW and finite per-owner heads; only PN_M may use paid DC/LEAF/OUT to bypass an active other-owner walk.
Payload for NVMe read is device-to-host WRITE; it is not host COPY or an extra host payload read.
Coupled read/write memory competition is a new research assumption; split_rw is an independently frozen structural control.
Unobserved completed maintenance prehistory is hypothetical; full known histories, seeds or initial states must be public to O0.
Device debt may survive host quiet while no host work remains; it cools during all charged elapsed time.
SQ/doorbell/PRP/SGL/PCIe/interconnect/coherence and separate real mapping translations are aggregated, not calibrated or claimed free.

source.initial_submit_order: owner then task; CPU cost per submit
source.command_rule: sequential LBA by own accepted-submit number; LBA separate from fixed host IOVA; no random seed
source.generation_rule: increment only upon accepted submit, after previous generation successful callback
source.drain_rule: Nth accepted submit seals this owner; remaining callbacks only free
source.error_rule: any submit or completion error rejects successful performance evidence

resources.IOTLB_replacement: per-owner LRU; normal/fast accepted hits touch; insertion only at successful walk completion
resources.backpressure: hold request and identity stable; count and reserve on accept only

provider.host_output: only at completed device work; enqueue payload translation; keep reserved data slot through payload/CQ/callback

prehistory_generator.mechanism: finish k sequential internal works with same heat/work/cooling rules, then idle r; no host obligations remain
prehistory_generator.declared_weight: uniform over (k,r) tuples, retaining duplicate terminal h weight; not an empirical distribution
prehistory_generator.known_to_O0: generator, support and weights; concrete tuple only when independently known

actions.P_M: same hardware/resource budget, N disabled; one ordinary TL, next normal request allowed immediately after its response handshake, independently of payload retirement
actions.PN_M: N enabled; at most one other-owner stable head begins DC1 then LEAF1 while ordinary walk active; LEAF checks actual model cached permission-valid 4KiB leaf. No accept on miss; one OUT/shared-response stage1. Only probe start needs active walk. New normal lookup blocked by DC/LEAF/OUT; PTE service continues. Reject until normal accept or candidate disappears.
actions.response: one response port, ready slow/fast round robin deterministic initial slow; response takes1; matching owner head released to reserved AW/payload queue, finite data credit already reserved; normal TL frees at slow response handshake, owner head cannot issue a second translation until downstream AW accepted
actions.cache_hit_permission: DDTC valid canonical Sv39/S1-only user ordinary W, w=1; no ATS/PRI/PID/debug/MSI/invalidations; these fixed model assumptions are public, not actual deployment facts
actions.counterfactual: each action recomputes all queue/service/CPU callback and resubmit events; provider never receives action
actions.equal_resource_limit: runtime same-budget mode comparison only; hypothetical P_prepare or other uses of N storage not implemented and not claimed beaten

topologies.coupled: one nonpreemptive FCFS server for PTE_R/PAYLOAD_W/CQ_W/POLL_R
topologies.split_rw: independent FCFS R and W servers; not a matched-area comparison

memory.PTE_dependency: next level emitted only after current return
memory.CQ_dependency: CQ write emitted only after all payload write work completes

CPU.workers: two logical owner workers scheduled by one round-robin CPU
CPU.poll_rule: visit non-ended owners round robin, one memory poll; return consumes at most one visible CQ; synchronous callback/resubmit before next visit

lifecycle_costs.warm: normal TL and actual modeled dependent PTE work, no host payload
lifecycle_costs.physical_cost_status: all synthetic nonzero service units; counter area/timing, actual CPU inference cost and deployment costs unknown

boundary_order: memory read finishes and CQ observation
event_semantics.debt_order: decrement during interval; at next boundary apply any finishing device-work heat before next work samples h
event_semantics.positive_work: all service jobs at least one; no infinite zero-time transitions

objective.J: first reference setup start through target successful work plus all callback/free/map-release/destroy/shared-quiet end
required_end: both owners exactly N submitted and N successful
pool mappings released and queues destroyed

observation.O0: all public configuration, mapping/addresses/permissions/QD/pool, command generator and actual commands, known seeds, full timestamped reference P_M CPU poll(empty/nonempty)/submit/CQ/status/callback/generation/free and boundary/action history
observation.grouping: exact full O0 only within same public configuration

Z.snapshot: latch at reference shared quiet; read only after snapshot, before target configuration
counters: ticks PTE ready/not-complete while payload actively serves
Z.overflow: saturate with explicit flag; no wrap
Z.split_rw_note: first counter denotes overlap, not proof of blocking

same-Z ordinary choice if value positive

acceptance: root must freeze exact executable semantics before implementation/results; implementation must preserve causal provenance and support independent invariant replay; model agreement alone is not acceptance
root_changes_to_proposal: P_M disables N probe; PN_M has single paid DC/LEAF/OUT probe, matching runtime action distinction. Proposed both-mode speculative prepare/store was rejected as an unimplemented extra interface, not called P.

Use fixed per-owner partition: total C=3 allocates [2,1], C=2 [1,1], C=4 [2,2]. Shared global FIFO was rejected as not partition P. Per-partition LRU, synthetic approximation not RTL PLRU equivalence.
Use three sequential dependent PTE reads for declared 4KiB Sv39 no-walk-cache model; no calibrated PTE timing.
One stable translation head per owner. Normal translation and shared response can release before payload finishes; never wait for payload/B before next normal TL.

N window only gates probe start, not later acceptance. Hold candidate; reject until normal acceptance or candidate disappears; cache port blocks new ordinary lookup during DC/LEAF/OUT, while in-progress PTE work may continue.
Reference P has no N probe, so replace proposed reference probe-hit counter by ready-PTE-not-in-service ticks; no free inactive-N sensor.
All-hit equivalence checked with equal elapsed boundary cost: P_M wait1 versus PN_M wait0 (mode write1); unmatched extra elapsed time may cool provider and alter service, which is not N benefit.
Ordinary delay menu [0,1,2,3] frozen for both modes. Z read/decision2 must fit its charged time context; compare same-time ordinary wait, no constant fee subtraction after run.

First gate only: if exact O0/Z offline information upper bound for registered menu is zero, do not fit Z policy or expand controls/grid. Value bounds are not deployed policies or natural distributions.

implementation_limits.unknown_deployment_inputs: native hardware, calibrated costs, timing/area, real joint trace/persistence/distribution all unknown
implementation_limits.trace_retention: summary every registered world/action/wait; complete event records for independent invariant verification, may deduplicate exact identical state/transition runs with explicit keys and retained prehistory weights
